sentences.en: Hello. This is 6 Minute English from BBC Learning English.
sentences.zh: 你好,这是英国广播公司英文课的6分钟英语课

sentences.en: I'm Phil. And I'm Beth. A list is a collection of items with a single item written on each line, and they're everywhere: shopping lists, to-do lists, even bucket lists – a list of all the things a person would like to do before they die.
sentences.zh: 我是菲尔,我叫贝丝。一个清单是每条线上写着一个单项的物品的集合, 它们无处不在:购物清单,待办清单,甚至桶清单—— 一份一个人死前想做的所有事情的清单。

sentences.en: In fact, there's an episode of 6 Minute English all about them*.
sentences.zh: 事实上,有一集 6分钟英语 全部关于他们*。

sentences.en: Imagine you're at the supermarket and find someone's shopping list.
sentences.zh: 想象一下你在超市 找到某人的购物单

sentences.en: This happens a lot to Jo Nolan, a linguistics researcher whose new book explores our love of lists.
sentences.zh: 这发生在Jo Nolan身上 他是一个语言研究家 他的新书探索了我们对名单的热爱

sentences.en: Here's Jo reading her shopping list on BBC Radio 4 programme Word of Mouth: I only list the first four items, but the list read: "Nanas, aye-aye, puke, shrooms."
sentences.zh: Jo在BBC电台4号节目《嘴边的文字》上读到她的购物清单:我只列出前四个项目,

sentences.en: "Nanas, aye-aye, puke, shrooms." Err… can you work out what Jo was buying at the supermarket, Phil?
sentences.zh: "Nanas, yeye, 呕吐, shrooms。" 呃... 你能弄清楚乔在超市买的东西吗,菲尔?

sentences.en: OK. Well, I'm going to guess that 'nanas' are bananas.
sentences.zh: 好吧,我猜"纳纳斯"是香蕉

sentences.en: And 'shrooms' – they've got to be mushrooms, right?
sentences.zh: 和"蘑菇" - 他们必须是蘑菇,对不对?

sentences.en: OK. But what about 'aye-aye' and ' puke '?
sentences.zh: 好吧,那"是"和"呕吐"呢?

sentences.en: What could they mean? Well, here's Jo's explanation to Michael Rosen, presenter of BBC Radio 4's Word of Mouth: And let's just come back to puke … I mean, were you instructing yourself to be sick in the supermarket?
sentences.zh: 他们是什么意思?这是乔给英国广播公司第四电台的主持人迈克尔·罗森的解释:让我们回到呕吐...

sentences.en: I'm just a bit lost there. No, it's slightly grotesque.
sentences.zh: 我只是有点迷路了 不,有点怪

sentences.en: Erm… my husband doesn't like cucumber, and the abbreviation for cucumber would be 'cuc', so he has always referred to it as puke.
sentences.zh: 呃... 我丈夫不喜欢黄瓜 黄瓜的缩写应该是"cuc" 所以他总是把它说成是呕吐

sentences.en: Aha! Cucumbers make Joanna's husband puke – a slang word for vomit.
sentences.zh: 黄瓜让乔安娜的丈夫呕吐 是个呕吐的词

sentences.en: And puke rhymes with 'cuc', so it's a way of reminding her to buy cucumbers.
sentences.zh: 和呕吐押韵 与"cuc", 所以这是一种方式 提醒她 买黄瓜。

sentences.en: Wow! Sometimes lists are like secret codes. ** In this episode, we'll find out why people love lists and learn some useful new words and phrases.
sentences.zh: 有时列表就像秘密代码。 **在这集中,我们会找出为什么人们喜欢列表 并学习一些有用的新词句。

sentences.en: And remember: you'll find another list – of all the vocabulary used – on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.zh: 并记住:你会在我们的网站上找到另一个单子——所有使用的词汇,bbclearingenglish.com。

sentences.en: But first, a question for you, Beth. According to the list on the Internet Movie Database website, which movie has made the most money ever?
sentences.zh: 但首先 问你一个问题 贝丝 根据互联网电影数据库网站的列表

sentences.en: Is it: a) Titanic, b) Avengers: Endgame, or c) Avatar?
sentences.zh: 是:a)泰坦尼克号,b)复仇者:结束游戏,或c)神通?

sentences.en: I think it might be Avatar, although that might have been the most expensive to make.
sentences.zh: 我想可能是阿凡达 虽然这也许是最贵的

sentences.en: I'm not sure. OK. Well, we'll find out at the end of the programme.
sentences.zh: 好吧,我们到节目结束时再查

sentences.en: Popular songs are full of lists, and one of the most famous is My Favourite Things, sung by Julie Andrews in the film The Sound of Music.
sentences.zh: 流行歌曲充满了列表, 其中最著名的是 我的最爱的东西, 由朱莉安德鲁斯唱 在电影《音乐的声音》。

sentences.en: The song lists all her favourite things, from 'raindrops on roses' to 'whiskers on kittens'.
sentences.zh: 这首歌列出了她最喜欢的东西,从玫瑰上的雨滴到小猫的口哨。

sentences.en: Here, Jo Nolan and Michael Rosen discuss the song on BBC Radio 4 programme Word of Mouth: I feel like you get a lot – you get a big bang for your buck in that song.
sentences.zh: Jo Nolan和Michael Rosen在BBC电台4个节目“嘴的字”中讨论这首歌:我觉得你得到了很多东西,

sentences.en: Maybe it's the positivity – it's a bit saccharine.
sentences.zh: 也许这是一种积极性 有点精致

sentences.en: Maybe that's also part of the issue. The list encourages you to think really efficiently and economically, so I think you don't waste a lot of time and effort making a nice sentence or using long words.
sentences.zh: 也许这也是问题的一部分。清单鼓励你思考 真正有效和经济, 所以我想你不会浪费很多时间和精力 做一个好的句子或用长长的词。

sentences.en: You just get to the nub of things quite quickly.
sentences.zh: 你只要很快地到达 事物的细小。

sentences.en: The song's list of 'favourite things' is long, and Jo says you get a big bang for your buck – an idiom meaning that you gain a lot in return for the money or effort you spend on something.
sentences.zh: 歌中「最喜悦的东西」的列表很长, Jo说,你得到了一顿盛大的歌声 — — 俗话说,你赚了很多钱或者花在某事上的努力。

sentences.en: But not everyone likes the song. Some call it saccharine – an adjective meaning excessively sweet, sentimental or insincere.
sentences.zh: 但并非每个人都喜欢这首歌。有人称之为“香水 ” — —一种形容词的意思是过度甜美、感情用事或缺乏诚意。

sentences.en: Lists often abbreviate the items they contain, so you get to the nub of things quickly.
sentences.zh: 列表通常缩略其所含项目, 所以您可以快速地找到事物的细点 。

sentences.en: The nub of something means the most important or essential point about it.
sentences.zh: 事物的细细 意味着它的最重要 或基本点。

sentences.en: Lists can be useful as well. Here's Jo Nolan giving an example of a useful list to BBC Radio 4's Word of Mouth: A friend of mine who makes pros and cons lists finds that it really helps her resolve a situation.
sentences.zh: 名单也可以有用。这是Jo Nolan给BBC电台4号的“嘴语”提供了一个有用的名单的例子:我的朋友做了赞成和反对名单,发现这确实有助于她解决问题。

sentences.en: She halves her page: pros, cons. And she said by the end of it, she knows what she's doing.
sentences.zh: 她把页数减半:亲,骗。她说,到最后,她知道自己在做什么。

sentences.en: Lists help us make decisions by writing down all the pros and cons of a situation.
sentences.zh: 列出清单有助于我们做出决策 写下局势的所有利弊

sentences.en: The pros and cons is another way of saying the advantages and disadvantages of something, especially when you're trying to choose between them.
sentences.zh: 利弊是表达某种东西的利弊的另一种方式 特别是当你试图在它们之间做出选择的时候

sentences.en: The more you think about it, the more you see lists everywhere – in menus and bank statements, for example.
sentences.zh: 你越想越多,你就越会看到到处都有的清单,例如菜单和银行对账单。

sentences.en: And therapists even recommend listing all the good things in your life to feel happier – not bad for a few words on a scrap of paper.
sentences.zh: 治疗师甚至建议列出你一生中所有美好的事物,

sentences.en: OK. It's time to reveal the answer to my question.
sentences.zh: 好了,现在该揭开我问题的答案了

sentences.en: Beth, I asked you which movie had made the most money ever, and you said Avatar.
sentences.zh: 贝丝,我问你哪部电影 赚的钱最多,你说阿凡达。

sentences.en: And now, according to the Internet Movie Database… that's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 而现在,根据互联网电影数据库... 这是正确的。

sentences.en: Yay! OK. Let's recap the vocabulary we've learned, starting with bucket list – all the things you would like to do before you die.
sentences.zh: 让我们总结一下我们学到的词汇,从桶名单开始,所有你死前想做的事。

sentences.en: Puke is slang for vomit or sick. If something gives bang for your buck, you gain a lot of extra value in return for the money or effort you put into it.
sentences.zh: 呕吐或生病都是废话。如果有东西能让你的心跳爆炸,你就会得到很多额外的价值来回报你投入其中的钱财或精力。

sentences.en: If you call something saccharine, you criticise it for being too sweet or sentimental.
sentences.zh: 如果你叫萨克林, 你批评它太甜 或感情用事。

sentences.en: The nub of a problem or situation is the most important or essential thing about it.
sentences.zh: 问题或局势的细微差别是最重要的问题或基本问题。

sentences.en: And finally, something's pros and cons are its advantages and disadvantages.
sentences.zh: 最后 利弊在于利弊

sentences.en: Once again, our six minutes are up, but remember – you'll find a quiz and worksheet for this episode over on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.zh: 我们的六分钟时间到了, 但请记住- 你会在我们的网站上找到这个节目的测验和工作单,

sentences.en: Goodbye for now! Bye!
sentences.zh: 再见,再见
